title: Whole-Team Pass-and-Move Circle
description: The whole group forms a big circle and passes one ball around while sliding one spot to the side, waking up the hands and feet together.

content.objective: Combine simple passing with constant lateral movement to raise the heart rate.
content.setup: The whole group forms one large circle with a couple of metres between each player.
instructions: Pass the ball to the player on your right, then slide two steps to your right.
Keep the circle moving continuously in the same direction.
After two minutes, reverse the passing direction and the sliding direction.
Finish with the ball travelling as fast as the group can safely manage.
coachingPoints: Catch before you slide — don't anticipate the catch.
Keep the circle evenly spaced as it rotates.
Call the receiver's name on every pass.
commonMistakes: Drifting the circle smaller or larger over time.
Passing before the receiver is ready.
Skipping the easier reps and going straight to full intensity.
content.safety: Keep the circle wide enough that sliding players don't collide.
